scenario: When a Salesforce opportunity moves to Closed Won, read the account, products, and contract term, create an onboarding project in Asana, post a handoff summary to the #customer-success Slack channel, and email the assigned CSM with the kickoff checklist.
rule_hooks: CSM assignment by segment and region

scenario: A demo request form submission lands in HubSpot; look up the company's employee count and country, assign the lead to the right SDR, set lead status to 'New - Demo Requested', and send the SDR a Slack DM with the lead details.

A rep sets a quote line discount in Salesforce above their allowed threshold; flag the quote as 'Pending Approval', look up the approver in the approval matrix sheet, and email the approver with deal size, margin, and justification.

When a DocuSign envelope for an order form is completed, attach the signed PDF to the HubSpot deal, set the deal stage to 'Contract Signed', update the contract start and end dates, and notify finance in Slack to set up billing.

A contract in the renewals Google Sheet reaches 90 days before its end date; create a renewal opportunity in Salesforce with the current ARR, assign it to the account owner, and email the owner with usage notes from the sheet.
rule_hooks: renewal lead time and uplift policy

scenario: A Zoom discovery meeting ends with the prospect never joining; log a 'No Show' activity on the HubSpot contact, increment the no-show counter, and send the prospect a reschedule email with the rep's Calendly link.

An email bounces or auto-replies that a key contact has left the company; mark the contact as 'Left Company' in Salesforce, remove their champion role on open opportunities, and Slack the account owner to identify a new contact.
rule_hooks: contact role and opportunity risk rules

scenario: A sent quote in HubSpot hits its expiration date without acceptance; mark the quote as expired, move the deal's next step to 'Re-quote', and email the rep asking whether to extend pricing.
rule_hooks: quote validity period by product line

scenario: An opportunity is moved backward from Negotiation to Discovery in Salesforce; record the regression reason in a pipeline-changes Google Sheet and notify the sales manager in Slack with the amount removed from commit.
A new opportunity is created with an amount above the strategic deal threshold; tag it as 'Strategic', add the VP of Sales to the opportunity team, and post a summary in the #big-deals Slack channel.

A new lead is created in Salesforce whose email domain matches an existing account; convert the lead under that account with the existing owner, and notify both the original lead owner and the account owner by email.

A prospect replies to a sequence email asking for pricing; pause the HubSpot sequence for that contact, set the lead status to 'Engaged', create a follow-up task due the next business day, and Slack the owning rep.
rule_hooks: reply intent categories and SLA hours

scenario: A contact replies 'remove me from your list'; set the HubSpot contact to unsubscribed, unenroll them from all sequences, add a do-not-contact flag in Salesforce, and log the request in the compliance sheet.
rule_hooks: opt-out handling and regional privacy rules

scenario: A product trial account crosses the usage threshold that marks it product-qualified; update the HubSpot contact's lifecycle stage to PQL, create a deal in the 'Self-Serve Expansion' pipeline, and email the assigned account executive.

QuickBooks marks a customer invoice 60 days overdue; flag the customer's open expansion opportunities in Salesforce as 'On Hold - AR', and email the account owner and collections contact with the invoice details.

A customer's legal team emails back a redlined MSA; save the attachment to the deal's Google Drive folder, set the opportunity's legal status to 'Redlines Received', and create a review ticket for the legal team in Jira.
rule_hooks: legal review queue and turnaround SLA

scenario: A prospect books a meeting through the rep's scheduling link; create a Google Calendar event with the Zoom link, move the HubSpot deal from 'Prospecting' to 'Meeting Scheduled', and credit the SDR who sourced the meeting in the SDR activity sheet.

HR posts that a rep has left the company; read the rep's accounts and open opportunities in Salesforce, reassign them per the territory coverage sheet, and email each affected customer contact an introduction from their new owner.

A Zendesk ticket is escalated to Urgent for an account with a renewal in the next 120 days; mark the renewal opportunity at risk in Salesforce, add the ticket link to its notes, and Slack the account manager and CSM.
rule_hooks: renewal window and ticket severity mapping

scenario: A customer emails a purchase order PDF; match the PO number and amount to the Closed Won opportunity, record the PO number on the opportunity, and notify the billing team in Slack, flagging any amount mismatch.

A call note logged in HubSpot mentions a named competitor; set the deal's 'Primary Competitor' field, attach the matching battlecard link to the deal, and notify the competitive intel channel in Slack.

An MQL assigned to an SDR has had no logged activity within the follow-up SLA; reassign the lead to the next SDR in the round-robin, log the breach in the SLA tracking sheet, and email the SDR manager.
rule_hooks: lead response SLA and round-robin order

scenario: A reseller submits a deal registration form; check the prospect against existing Salesforce opportunities for conflicts, create a partner-sourced opportunity if clear, and email the partner manager and partner with the approval or rejection.
rule_hooks: deal registration conflict and exclusivity rules

scenario: A mutual NDA is completed in DocuSign; update the account's NDA status and expiry date in Salesforce, and email the prospect the security questionnaire and technical documentation from the shared drive.

A prospect emails a vendor security questionnaire; create a task in the security team's Asana project with the due date, set the opportunity's 'Security Review' field to In Progress, and reply to the prospect with the expected turnaround.
rule_hooks: security review SLA by deal size

scenario: The billing system reports a customer exceeding their licensed seat count; create an expansion opportunity in Salesforce for the overage seats at the contracted unit price, and email the account manager with the usage report.
rule_hooks: contracted price book and overage policy

scenario: A customer emails notice of non-renewal; set the renewal opportunity to Closed Lost with the stated reason, update the account status to 'Churning', and notify the CS lead and finance in Slack with the ARR impact.
rule_hooks: churn reason taxonomy and notice period terms

scenario: An opportunity is marked Closed Lost with reason 'Timing'; enroll the primary contact in the HubSpot re-engagement nurture, set a re-open reminder task for the owner six months out, and update the account's lifecycle stage.
rule_hooks: loss reason to nurture track mapping

scenario: A trade show organizer emails a badge-scan export; create or update the contacts in HubSpot with the event as lead source, assign them to reps by territory, and Slack each rep a list of their new event leads.
rule_hooks: territory assignment and lead source naming

scenario: A prospect accepts a quote in HubSpot; create the customer and draft invoice in Xero with the quoted line items and payment terms, and email the rep and finance to confirm the order.

An opportunity's close date passes while still open; push the close date per the rep's update or flag it 'Past Due', recalculate the quarter's commit in the forecast sheet, and email the rep's manager.
rule_hooks: forecast quarter boundaries and past-due policy

scenario: An account owner requests an executive sponsor meeting via a Slack form; look up the assigned exec for the account tier, send a calendar invite with the customer contacts, and log the exec engagement on the Salesforce account.
rule_hooks: account tier to exec sponsor mapping

scenario: A signed contract amendment adding products comes back via DocuSign; update the account's subscription products and ARR in Salesforce, update the renewal opportunity amount, and notify finance with the prorated amount.

A third-party intent provider flags a target account surging on a relevant topic; update the account's intent score and tier in Salesforce, and send the assigned rep a Slack alert with the topics and contacts to prioritize.

An existing customer emails an introduction to a peer company; create the lead in HubSpot with 'Customer Referral' source and the referrer linked, assign it to the territory rep, and send the referrer a thank-you email.
rule_hooks: referral program attribution and reward rules

scenario: A quote is generated with a term longer than 36 months or non-standard payment terms; set the quote status to 'Finance Review', and email the deal desk with the term, payment schedule, and total contract value.

A sales manager's weekly pipeline review calendar event is one day away; pull their team's opportunities closing this quarter from Salesforce into a review tab in Google Sheets and email the manager the link with flagged stale deals.
rule_hooks: stale deal criteria by stage age

scenario: A customer emails that their billing entity and address have changed; update the account billing address in Salesforce and the contact record in QuickBooks, and notify the account owner that a new tax form may be needed.
rule_hooks: billing entity and tax jurisdiction rules

scenario: An Intercom chat from a website visitor is tagged 'Sales Inquiry' by support; create a lead in Salesforce with the chat transcript, assign it to the inbound queue owner on duty, and post the conversation link in the #inbound-leads channel.

A rep submits a request in Slack claiming split credit on a Closed Won deal; look up the opportunity team and sourcing records, update the split percentages in the commissions sheet if the policy allows, and email both reps and the sales ops lead with the outcome.

A sales sequence email to a key contact hard-bounces in Gmail. The agent marks the HubSpot contact's email invalid, removes it from active sequences, searches the account for another contact with the same buying role, and creates a Salesforce task for the owner to find a replacement.
rule_hooks: bounce type codes, buying-role priority list

scenario: An AE posts an out-of-office block in Google Calendar for an upcoming week. The agent finds the AE's open opportunities with close dates or meetings in that window, assigns a covering rep from the team coverage sheet, adds the covering rep to the meetings, and posts the handoff list in the team Slack channel.
rule_hooks: coverage matrix by team/segment, close-date window

scenario: A rep moves a Salesforce opportunity to 'Proposal' while required qualification fields (economic buyer, decision criteria, paper process) are blank. The agent reverts the stage, records which fields are missing in a note, and DMs the rep on Slack.

A prospect's procurement contact emails asking for net-90 terms and quarterly billing. The agent checks the deal amount and customer segment against the payment-terms policy, auto-approves terms within policy or opens a deal-desk approval request for exceptions, and logs the request on the opportunity.
rule_hooks: payment terms policy by deal size and segment

scenario: An AE submits a form asking for professional services on a deal (data migration, custom integration). The agent creates a scoping ticket in the PS project board, attaches the opportunity details, assigns a solutions architect by service type, and adds a 'Services pending' flag to the opportunity.
rule_hooks: PS rate card and service-type assignment table

scenario: A rep posts in the #se-requests Slack channel asking for a sales engineer for a technical deep-dive. The agent picks an SE by product specialization and current open-request load, books the SE onto the prospect meeting in Google Calendar, and records the SE on the Salesforce opportunity team.

An RFP document arrives by email from a prospect. The agent creates or updates the opportunity with the RFP type and due date, builds a response task list in Asana with internal deadlines worked back from the submission date, and notifies the proposal manager with the go/no-go scorecard inputs.

A new customer's AP team emails asking for a W-9, bank letter, and supplier portal (Coupa/Ariba) registration before they can issue payment. The agent attaches the current approved documents from Google Drive, creates a finance task for the portal registration, and logs the activity on the account.
rule_hooks: approved document library, finance-owned vs sales-owned items

scenario: A customer emails a sales tax exemption certificate for a pending order. The agent checks the certificate's state and expiry, marks the customer tax-exempt in QuickBooks and on the CRM account, and tells billing to reissue the draft invoice without tax.
rule_hooks: state exemption validity rules, certificate expiry

scenario: A first-time customer's opportunity reaches 'Negotiation' with an amount above the credit review threshold. The agent requests a credit check from finance, puts a 'credit pending' hold on the quote, and updates the allowed payment terms on the account once finance assigns a credit limit.
rule_hooks: credit review thresholds, terms allowed per credit band

scenario: RevOps publishes a new price book effective next month. The agent finds open quotes that use SKUs whose prices changed, labels each as grandfathered or requiring a requote based on quote date and expiry, and notifies each quote owner with the price differences.

A quote is created in USD for an account whose billing address is in Germany. The agent checks the billing-entity and currency table, flags the quote, updates the opportunity with the correct selling entity and currency, and asks the rep to regenerate the quote.

Zoom webinar attendance data comes in after a product webinar. For attendees who belong to existing open-opportunity accounts, the agent logs the attendance on the contact and creates a follow-up task for the account owner, with priority set by how long the person watched and which questions they asked.
rule_hooks: attendance duration tiers, open-opp vs net-new routing

scenario: A Zoom discovery call transcript summary arrives listing agreed next steps and a new stakeholder. The agent updates the opportunity's Next Step and next-step date, adds the new stakeholder as a contact with a role, and creates the follow-up tasks with their due dates.
rule_hooks: next-step field conventions, contact role picklist

scenario: A news alert or customer email reports that an existing customer was acquired by another company that already exists in the CRM. The agent links the parent-child account hierarchy, checks whether the two accounts have different owners or segments, and notifies both owners and their managers.
rule_hooks: account hierarchy ownership rules, segment precedence

scenario: A new account's name or country matches an entry on the export-control screening list during lead conversion. The agent puts the opportunity on compliance hold, blocks quote creation, and opens a review ticket with legal that includes the match details.

A closed-won booking takes a rep past 100% of quarterly quota. The agent updates the attainment tracker in Google Sheets, applies the accelerator tier to the rep's commission estimate, and posts a congratulations message in the team Slack channel tagging the manager.

A deal closes that includes a product line in the current quarter's SPIFF program. The agent checks eligibility (new logo, minimum term, SKU), logs the payout row in the SPIFF sheet, and notifies the rep and sales ops.
rule_hooks: SPIFF eligibility criteria and payout amounts

scenario: A rep changes an opportunity's forecast category to 'Commit'. The agent checks the commit criteria (signer identified, legal engaged, close date this quarter, quote sent), updates the forecast roll-up sheet if they pass, or reverts the category to 'Best Case' and tells the rep which items are missing.

A rep requests a customer reference call for a late-stage deal. The agent finds reference-program customers that match the prospect's industry, size, and use case, excludes those already used to the quarterly limit, and emails the matched customer's CSM to ask for an intro.
rule_hooks: reference program roster, reference fatigue limits

scenario: A customer replies by email approving use of their logo and a case study. The agent updates the account's marketing-permission fields with scope and expiry, saves the approval email to the account's Drive folder, and notifies the marketing team in Slack.
rule_hooks: permission scope types (logo, quote, case study), expiry

scenario: A prospect emails the results of their proof-of-concept against agreed success criteria. The agent compares the results with the success criteria recorded on the opportunity, moves the stage forward and asks the deal desk for a quote if the criteria were met, or flags the gaps to the rep and SE.
rule_hooks: POC success criteria, stage advancement rule

scenario: A contact at an account that was closed-lost four months ago fills out a pricing form. The agent checks whether the original AE's reclaim window is still open, then either reopens the opportunity under that AE or routes it as a new lead, and notifies whoever ends up owning it with the prior loss reason.

A prospect reschedules a demo through the scheduling link. The agent updates the internal calendar event, makes sure the assigned SE is free at the new time (or swaps in another SE), moves the opportunity's next-step date, and updates the pre-demo prep task due date.

An AE rejects an SDR-sourced opportunity as unqualified. The agent records the rejection reason, converts the opportunity back to a nurture lead assigned to the SDR, removes the SDR's pipeline credit in the tracking sheet, and notifies the SDR manager if the rejection rate passes a threshold.

A renewal quote is generated with a standard price increase. The agent reads the customer's MSA terms for a contractual uplift cap, adjusts the quote if the increase is over the cap, and notes the change on the renewal opportunity for the account manager.

A customer emails asking to add a new module halfway through their contract. The agent builds a co-termed add-on quote with prorated pricing to the current end date, creates an expansion opportunity linked to the account, and sends the quote to the AM for review.

A customer tells their AM they want to cut seats at renewal. The agent checks the contract's minimum seat commitment and tier pricing breakpoints, updates the renewal opportunity amount and forecast, and alerts the AM's manager if the reduction is above the downsell review threshold.

An enrichment update changes an account's employee count from 180 to 1,400. The agent recalculates the account's segment, moves the account and its open leads to the mid-market team's round-robin if the segment changed, and notifies both the old and new owners.

The HubSpot-Salesforce sync reports a field conflict on a contact's lifecycle stage. The agent applies the system-of-record precedence for that field, corrects the losing system, and logs the conflict in the RevOps data-quality sheet.

A signed order form comes back from DocuSign signed by someone who is not on the customer's authorized-signer list or is below the required title. The agent keeps the opportunity from being booked, alerts the rep and deal desk, and drafts a request for an authorized countersignature.
rule_hooks: signature authority policy by deal amount

scenario: A rep requests approval to send a gift basket to a prospect's evaluation team. The agent checks the recipient's sector (government or regulated) and the per-person gift limit, approves or rejects the request, and logs the expense against the opportunity.

A deal above the review threshold closes as won or lost against a named competitor. The agent creates a win/loss interview request in the program tracker, emails the buyer contact with scheduling options, and notifies product marketing.

A rep marks a missing feature as a deal blocker on an opportunity. The agent finds or creates the matching feature request in the product tracker, links the opportunity and its ARR to it, and posts the revenue-at-risk total to the product team's Slack channel.

QuickBooks records payment of a new customer's first invoice. The agent changes the CRM account status from 'Pending payment' to 'Active customer', unlocks the provisioning task, and notifies the assigned CSM and the AE.

During qualification, a rep marks an account as a state agency. The agent moves the opportunity to the public-sector team, checks whether the agency can buy through an existing contract vehicle or reseller, and updates the opportunity's procurement path field.
rule_hooks: public-sector routing rules, contract vehicle list

scenario: A large opportunity is closed-lost and the rep's open pipeline for the quarter falls below 3x remaining quota. The agent recalculates coverage in the pipeline sheet, alerts the rep's manager in Slack, and creates a pipeline-generation task for the rep.

A customer meeting on a rep's calendar includes attendees whose email addresses are not in the CRM. The agent matches each email domain to an account, creates the contacts with titles from their email signatures, links them to the open opportunity, and logs the meeting activity.

A prospect replies to an outbound sequence step. The agent pauses the sequence and sorts the reply as interested, out-of-office, wrong person with a referral, or not now. Depending on the category, it creates a hot task, resumes the sequence after the return date, adds and enrolls the referred contact, or sets a recontact date.

A reseller partner emails asking for a quote for one of their end customers. The agent checks the partner's tier and whether the deal is registered, applies the matching partner discount, creates the quote under the partner-sourced opportunity, and sends it to the partner manager for release.
rule_hooks: partner tier discount schedule, registration status
